evidence.role: Official announcement: August 26 2020 free update, nine new fighting techniques.
Official America announcement: Supreme Kai of Time, Conton City World Tournament, and customizable skills.
Independent catalog enumerates the nine named skills.

boundaries: Official Bandai Namco announcement gives the count but not all nine names in the prose; named identity is corroborated by the maintained independent catalog and existing canonical repository records.
Divine Kamehameha, Soaring Fist, and Godly Display are included in the nine-skill set because the maintained Free Update catalog explicitly groups them with the six Supreme Kai of Time skills.
No canonical skill records are created or renamed.
Release date 2020-08-26 is event provenance, not a game version or patch label.
